proofs.POS_Htarget_replay_scope: Frozen execution asserts exact Htarget replay each batch; this CPU audit verifies source/pin/population and completion, does not rerun prefix or native hooks.
proofs.native_row_order_and_weight_scope: Frozen native_trace records actual expert hooks, checks selected-sub-batch row order and BF16 applied-weight products. Statistical audit does not rerun those calls.

method: Independent NumPy float64 aggregation: all global points,1000 seed137 file/word CIs and all64 expert count/energy/error rows. No primary helper imports.
scope: Statistics only, not native-hook reexecution or FP64 forward. FP64 reference accumulates the same FP32 delta components; native BF16 product/sum/query-shape floors stay separate from cross-error compensation.
CI_scope: Fixed models/populations only, no seed CI; undefined ratios and experts retained without filtering. POS points are pooled SSE/count or own-energy ratios, with word-cluster bootstrap; they are not equal-word means of per-word ratios.

POS_scalar_A_support_boundary.mechanism: For raw held A_e(x)=0, row-centering produces -mean_j A_j(x), followed by a cal-word offset. This can vary with x even though e never contributes at these held targets. Numeric64-column validity is not64 observed natural content roles. The cal offsets may differ by expert, so the residual columns need not be identical.
POS_scalar_A_support_boundary.no_score_changes: All original64-column main estimates/CI retained; no post-hoc expert deletion, replacement score or initial-baseline subtraction.
POS_scalar_A_support_boundary.Dolma_on_support_coverage: All64 experts have actual on-support occurrences on262144 held positions; min count15074.
